mutants.what: dedupe-hit logEvent loses { skipWitness: true }
dedupe key gains a 5th part (token label)
comment create checks trashed after the dedupe lookup
attachments upload the file before the trashed check
comment delete no longer bumps the dedupe generation
comment edit no longer bumps the dedupe generation
PATCH awaits onTicketWrite before responding (a rejecting closer now changes the response)
PATCH /issues/:id stops forwarding { source } to resolveProviderAccess (amendment: must read red)
POST /issues starts forwarding { source } (it must stay ignored)
attachments validates `target` before resolving the provider (a bad target now beats a 503 / capability refusal)
PATCH never refuses a periodical task on the report gate
adding an already-present label writes instead of returning the 200 no-op
removing an absent label writes instead of returning the 200 no-op
comment create invalid-issueId 400 (unlogged today) is now logged
relation create logs '/api/proxy/issues/relation' (typo) on success
suggest-dismissal no longer clears the sessions feed cache
suggest-answer no longer clears the sessions feed cache
includeResolved is truthy instead of === 'true'
sessionsFeedCache namespace 'rulings' instead of 'proxy-rulings'
suggest-dismissal trims the reason before the store call
suggest-dismissal checks the store (503) after the ruling lookup instead of before
POST /issues passes { source: undefined } (identical to passing nothing: resolveProviderAccess destructures it either way)
